entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Petitioner :- Toolika Yadav
Respondent :- The State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Neha Bano,Om Prakash Vishwakarma,Shri Ram Pandey

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajiv Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Harvir Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned AGA for the State and perused the record.

2. The instant writ petition has been filed by the petitioner for the following reliefs:
"(i) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding and directing to the respondent no. 3 to complete the investigation and submit chargesheet in Case Crime No. 267 of 2022, under Section 420 I.P.C. and Section Toolika Yadav vs The State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 4 June, 2025

entities.text: Section Toolika Yadav vs The State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PROVISION

sentences.text:
Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150861382/
1 66D I.T. Amendment Act, 2008, P.S. Colongelganj, District Prayagraj.
(ii) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding the respondent no, 3 to arrest the respondent no. 4 in Case Crime No. 267 of 2022, under Section 420 I.P.C. and Section 66D I.T. Amendment Act, 2008,
(iii) Issue any other writ, order or direction in the nature of which this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper in the circumstances of the case.

(iv) Award the cost of proceeding of the writ petition to the petitioner."
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is the first informant in the present case and though the FIR in the instant case has been registered on 09.06.2022, yet the police is not investigating the case in fair and impartial manner.
4. In view of the above, the petitioner may move an application before the Police Commissioner,
Prayagraj, District Prayagraj, highlighting his grievance and seeking fair and impartial investigation and if such an application is moved before the Police Commissioner, Prayagraj, District Prayagraj,
the Police Commissioner, Prayagraj, District Prayagraj/respondent no. 2 shall ensure the fair,
impartial and expeditious investigation in the present case.
5. With the aforesaid order, the present petition stands disposed of.
